result.instructions: Tools for ServiceTrade, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are overdue this week, and at which locations?"; "List the open deficiencies at our biggest customer's sites, worst severity first."; "Which invoices from the last 30 days are still unpaid?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ServiceTrade data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run servicetrade_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run servicetrade_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run servicetrade_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. servicetrade_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (service calls, inspections, installs) with status, type, customer, location, owner, due date and estimated price. Filter by status, type, location, customer, technician, due or completion dates. ServiceTrade API: GET /job.

status.description: Job status or comma-separated list: new, scheduled, canceled, bidding, completed, pending_invoice, sending_invoice, invoiced, closed.

type.description: Job type or comma-separated list, e.g. inspection, repair, emergency_service_call, installation.

locationId.description: Only jobs at this location id.

customerId.description: Only jobs for this customer company id.

techId.description: Only jobs assigned to this technician user id.

dueByBegin.description: Earliest due date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

dueByEnd.description: Latest due date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

completedOnBegin.description: Earliest completion date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

completedOnEnd.description: Latest completion date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

createdAfter.description: Created after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updatedAfter.description: Updated after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List customer service locations (sites) with address, company, status and tags. ServiceTrade API: GET /location.

companyId.description: Only locations of this company id.

updatedAfter.description: Updated after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (customers, vendors, contractors) with city, state and status. ServiceTrade API: GET /company.

updatedAfter.description: Updated after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List scheduled appointments (technician visits) with time window, job, location and assigned technicians. ServiceTrade API: GET /appointment.

jobId.description: Only appointments of this job id.

locationId.description: Only appointments at this location id.

techIds.description: Technician user id or comma-separated ids.

windowBeginsAfter.description: Window starts after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

windowBeginsBefore.description: Window starts before as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_service_requests
tools.title: List service requests
tools.description: List service requests (the work items to perform on a job, with description, service line and window). ServiceTrade API: GET /servicerequest.

jobId.description: Only requests of this job id.

locationId.description: Only requests at this location id.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_deficiencies
tools.title: List deficiencies
tools.description: List deficiencies (problems found during inspections, such as fire or life-safety defects) with severity, status and asset. ServiceTrade API: GET /deficiency.

severity.description: Severity filter, e.g. deficient, impairment, suggested.

status.description: Status or comma-separated list: new, invalid, verified, fixed.

assetId.description: Only deficiencies of this asset id.

locationId.description: Only deficiencies at this location id.

companyId.description: Only deficiencies of this company id.

createdAfter.description: Created after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List assets (equipment such as extinguishers, panels, pumps) at customer locations with type, status and name. ServiceTrade API: GET /asset.

locationId.description: Only assets at this location id.

jobId.description: Only assets of this job id.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes with status, customer, location, total and expiry. ServiceTrade API: GET /quote.

status.description: Status or comma-separated list: accepted, canceled, draft, new, rejected, submitted, pending_sales_tax.

customerId.description: Only quotes for this customer company id.

locationId.description: Only quotes at this location id.

jobId.description: Only quotes linked to this job id.

createdAfter.description: Created after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, customer, job, totals, due date and paid state. ServiceTrade API: GET /invoice.

jobId.description: Only invoices of this job id.

customerId.description: Only invoices for this customer company id.

locationId.description: Only invoices at this location id.

paid.description: true = only paid, false = only unpaid.

createdAfter.description: Created after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

transactionDateAfter.description: Transaction date after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

transactionDateBefore.description: Transaction date before as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List service contracts and agreements with customer, location, review date and active state. ServiceTrade API: GET /contract.

customerId.description: Only contracts for this customer company id.

locationId.description: Only contracts at this location id.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (technicians, sales staff, office staff and customer contacts) with company and status. ServiceTrade API: GET /user.

companyId.description: Only users of this company id.

tools.name: servicetrade_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List comments on one record. Pass the entity type number and the record id (Asset 2, Job 3, Invoice 6, Quote 9, Deficiency 10, Location 11). ServiceTrade API: GET /comment.

entityType.description: Entity type number: Asset 2, Job 3, Invoice 6, Quote 9, Deficiency 10, Location 11.

visibility.description: Visibility filter: public, schedule, tech or billing.

createdAfter.description: Created after as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: servicetrade_get_location

tools.name: servicetrade_get_company
tools.title: Get a company

tools.name: servicetrade_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by id with window, technicians and job. ServiceTrade API: GET /appointment/{id}.

tools.name: servicetrade_get_deficiency

tools.name: servicetrade_get_asset

tools.name: servicetrade_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get one quote by id with status, line items and totals. ServiceTrade API: GET /quote/{id}.

tools.name: servicetrade_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice

tools.name: servicetrade_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected credential
tools.description: Show which ServiceTrade account, company, user and timezone the connected credential belongs to. ServiceTrade API: GET /oauth2/userinfo.

tools.name: servicetrade_add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a record
tools.description: WRITE: add a new comment to a job, asset, invoice, quote, deficiency or location. Each call creates one more comment (not idempotent: do not retry blindly). ServiceTrade API: POST /comment.

entityType.description: The kind of record to comment on.

visibility.description: Who can see it (default: ServiceTrade default). Assets accept only public and tech.

annotations.title: Add a comment to a record
